name: Volia
sum: Mekosuchine from the Pleistocene of Fiji, 2–3 m long and probably the island's apex predator.
holotype: Type material from Voli Voli Cave, Viti Levu, Fiji (Molnar et al. 2002).
material: Largely fragmentary skull and limb bones from caves on Viti Levu and similar remains from Naigani.
biology: The largest predator on Viti Levu and probably its apex predator.
author: Molnar et al. 2002
